description: Staged dialogue control for everyday-conversation practice (turn-taking, listening, follow-up questions, small talk, clarity). Stages have entry/exit conditions; the coach module controls transitions; the persona module only generates turns within the active stage. Adapted from the Phase 3 sparring 5-stage core. Grounding (VERIFIED): the sparring core's evidence base applies here — EasyMED 2025 (separated persona/coach modules, psychological safety), AgentForge 2026 (visible coordination demands drive learning). Adaptation decisions below are RECONSTRUCTED.

changed: ADDED 'repair' stage between explore and challenge: everyday conversation practice targets clarity explicitly (misunderstandings, vague answers, clarification requests), which the sparring core had no stage for (RECONSTRUCTED design decision; no direct study — grounded in the domain's clarity target and in dialogue-repair practice being a first-class conversational skill)

REDEFINED 'challenge' semantics: in the sparring core it is argumentative pushback; in Conversation_Dojo it is calibrated conversational friction — topic shifts, interruptions, minimal responses, vague replies — within the agreed intensity profile, never argument (RECONSTRUCTED mapping)
FOLDED small talk into engage+explore: engage opens small-talk topics; explore extends them via follow-up questions; small_talk markers tracked as stage state (RECONSTRUCTED)
